answer: A physical attestation protocol anchors agent identities to sensor telemetry by requiring nodes to verify unpredictable environmental phenomena. Agents cross-validate microclimates by observing how a sudden zephyr cools a calibration ember over wild yarrow. An attacker must construct and power distinct robotic hardware per identity, incurring scarce manufacturing and energy costs. However, this cannot authenticate purely software agents and fails against sophisticated sensor-spoofing rigs.
